signal_grades.note: Each signal is tested on its own: when it appeared, did SPCX move the way it predicts 5 trading days later (daily) or 7 hours later (hourly)? "Helpful" means right at least 58% of the time with a positive average move, "Misleading" means wrong more often than right, and "Too few" means under 10 examples so far.

today_paragraph: SPCX closed at $127.32, up 1.2% today. The daily trend is down: price is below its 20-day average, which is below the 50-day. The overall score is bearish (-45). Options look fairly priced, assuming 68% yearly volatility versus 73% the stock has actually shown. Next up: standard 180-day IPO lockup ends (~797.6M shares) in 13 days. Lockups let insiders sell more shares, which can add selling pressure.
